anchors:
  list:
    - &CENTER { "x": 1, "y": 2 }
    - &LEFT   { "x": 0, "y": 2 }
    - &BIG    { "r": 10 }
    - &SMALL  { "r": 1 }

# All the following maps are equal:

plain:
  # Explicit keys
  "x": 1
  "y": 2
  "r": 10
  label: center/big

mergeOne:
  # Merge one map
  << : *CENTER
  "r": 10
  label: center/big

mergeMultiple:
  # Merge multiple maps
  << : [ *CENTER, *BIG ]
  label: center/big

override:
  # Override
  << : [ *BIG, *LEFT, *SMALL ]
  "x": 1
  label: center/big

shortTag:
  # Explicit short merge tag
  !!merge "<<" : [ *CENTER, *BIG ]
  label: center/big

longTag:
  # Explicit merge long tag
  !<tag:yaml.org,2002:merge> "<<" : [ *CENTER, *BIG ]
  label: center/big

inlineMap:
  # Inlined map 
  << : {"x": 1, "y": 2, "r": 10}
  label: center/big

inlineSequenceMap:
  # Inlined map in sequence
  << : [ *CENTER, {"r": 10} ]
  label: center/big

    <<: *mergeouter2
    inner:
        a: -1
        b: -2

outer:
    <<: [*mergeinner1, *mergeinner2]
    f: 60
